He wouldn't do a thing like that again! There was another sergeant--not Fitzgerald--who'd found a set of four new white-walls tires on his doorstep, and was ostracized by his teen-age offspring when he turned them into the police Lost and Found.

27873-the-spirit-of-rome.title: The Spirit Of Rome
27873-the-spirit-of-rome.creator: Unknown
27873-the-spirit-of-rome.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I was brought up in Rome, from the age of twelve to that of seventeen, but did not return there for many years afterwards. I discovered it anew for myself, while knowing all its sites and its details; discovered, that is to say, its meaning to my thoughts and feelings.

arxiv-1905-03184.title: Implementing Efficient Message Logging Protocols as MPI Application Extensions
arxiv-1905-03184.creator: Kiril Dichev, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos
arxiv-1905-03184.description: Abstract . Message logging protocols are enablers of local rollback, a more efficient alternative to global rollback, for fault tolerant MPI applications. Until now, message logging MPI implementations have incurred the overheads of a redesign and redeployment of an MPI library, as well as continued performance penalties across various kernels.

arxiv-2010-15251.title: Fusion Models for Improved Visual Captioning
arxiv-2010-15251.creator: Marimuthu Kalimuthu, Aditya Mogadala, Marius Mosbach, Dietrich Klakow
arxiv-2010-15251.description: Abstract Visual captioning aims to generate textual descriptions given images or videos. Traditionally, image captioning models are trained on human annotated datasets such as Flickr30k and MS-COCO, which are limited in size and diversity. This limitation hinders the generalization capabilities of these models while also rendering them liable to making mistakes.

arxiv-2104-10867.title: Forbidden subgraphs in generating graphs of finite groups
arxiv-2104-10867.creator: Andrea Lucchini, Daniele Nemmi
arxiv-2104-10867.description: Abstract . Let G G be a 2 2 -generated group. The generating graph Γ ⁡ ( G ) \Gamma(G) is the graph whose vertices are the elements of G G and where two vertices g 1 g_{1} and g 2 g_{2} are adjacent if G = ⟨ g 1 , g 2 ⟩ . G=\langle g_{1},g_{2}\rangle.

arxiv-2202-11458.title: Initial data on big bang singularities in symmetric settings
arxiv-2202-11458.creator: Hans Ringström
arxiv-2202-11458.description: Abstract . In a recent article, we propose a general geometric notion of initial data on big bang singularities. This notion is of interest in its own right. However, it also serves the purpose of giving a unified perspective on many of the results in the literature.

arxiv-2211-10839.title: Pseudo-value regression of clustered multistate current status data with informative cluster sizes
arxiv-2211-10839.creator: Samuel Anyaso-Samuel, Dipankar Bandyopadhyay, Somnath Datta
arxiv-2211-10839.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Samuel Anyaso-Samuel, Dipankar Bandyopadhyay, Somnath Datta. Multistate current status (CS) data presents a more severe form of censoring due to the single observation of study participants transitioning through a sequence of well-defined disease states at random inspection times. Moreover, these data may be clustered within specified groups, and informativeness of the cluster sizes may arise due to the existing latent relationship between the transition outcomes and the cluster sizes. Failure to adjust for this informativeness may lead to a biased inference.

arxiv-2308-13253.title: Impact of hot exozodiacal dust on the polarimetric analysis of close-in exoplanets
arxiv-2308-13253.creator: K. Ollmann, S. Wolf, M. Lietzow, T. A. Stuber
arxiv-2308-13253.description: Abstract Context. Hot exozodiacal dust (HEZD) found around main-sequence stars through interferometric observations in the photometric bands H H to L L is located close to the dust sublimation radius, potentially at orbital radii comparable to those of close-in exoplanets. Consequently, HEZD has a potential influence on the analysis of the scattered-light polarization of close-in exoplanets and vice versa. Aims.

arxiv-2502-15013.title: Towards Physics-Guided Foundation Models
arxiv-2502-15013.creator: Majid Farhadloo, Arun Sharma, Mingzhou Yang, Bharat Jayaprakash, William Northrop, Shashi Shekhar
arxiv-2502-15013.description: Abstract Traditional foundation models are pre-trained on broad datasets to reduce the training resources (e.g., time, energy, labeled samples) needed for fine-tuning to a wide range of downstream tasks. However, traditional foundation models struggle with out-of-distribution prediction and can produce outputs that are unrealistic and physically infeasible.

arxiv-2510-25147.title: Machine Learning Guided Optimal Transmission Switching to Mitigate Wildfire Ignition Risk
arxiv-2510-25147.creator: Weimin Huang, Bistra Dilkina, Ryan Piansky, Daniel K. Molzahn
arxiv-2510-25147.description: Abstract To mitigate acute wildfire ignition risks, utilities de-energize power lines in high-risk areas. The Optimal Power Shutoff (OPS) problem optimizes line energization statuses to manage wildfire ignition risks through de-energizations while reducing load shedding. OPS problems are computationally challenging Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs) that must be solved rapidly and frequently in operational settings.

arxiv-2511-03704.title: Long-Lasting and Slowly Varying Transient Dynamics in Discrete-Time Systems
arxiv-2511-03704.creator: Anthony Pasion a, b and Felicia Maria Magpantay a
arxiv-2511-03704.description: Abstract Analysis of mathematical models in ecology and epidemiology often focuses on asymptotic dynamics, such as stable equilibria and periodic orbits. However, many systems exhibit long transient behaviors where certain aspects of the dynamics remain in a slowly evolving state for an extended period before undergoing rapid change.

britannica-1911-cordova-city.title: Cordova (city) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-cordova-city.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cordova-city.description: Article 'Cordova (city)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Spanish province of Cordova, on the southern slopes of the Sierra de Cordova, and the right bank of the river Guadalquivir. At Cordova the Madrid-Seville railway meets the branch line from Almorchón to Málaga. The city is an episcopal see.

in-troubadour-land-a-ramble-in-provence-.title: In Troubadour-Land: A Ramble in Provence and Languedoc
in-troubadour-land-a-ramble-in-provence-.creator: S. (Sabine) Baring-Gould

pmc-10672244.title: Recent Progress of In Vitro 3D Culture of Male Germ Stem Cells
pmc-10672244.creator: Jiang Wu, Kai Kang, Siqi Liu, Yaodan Ma, Meng Yu, Xin Zhao, Sorina Dinescu
pmc-10672244.description: Male germline stem cells (mGSCs), also known as spermatogonial stem cells (SSCs), are the fundamental seed cells of male animal reproductive physiology. However, environmental influences, drugs, and harmful substances often pose challenges to SSCs, such as population reduction and quality decline.

pmc-11437666.title: A Bayesian multivariate hierarchical model for developing a treatment benefit index using mixed types of outcomes
pmc-11437666.creator: Danni Wu, Keith S. Goldfeld, Eva Petkova, Hyung G. Park
pmc-11437666.description: BackgroundPrecision medicine has led to the development of targeted treatment strategies tailored to individual patients based on their characteristics and disease manifestations. Although precision medicine often focuses on a single health outcome for individualized treatment decision rules (ITRs), relying only on a single outcome rather than all available outcomes information leads to suboptimal data usage when developing optimal ITRs.

pmc-11498074.title: Awareness and Knowledge of Adverse Drug Reactions and Pharmacovigilance Among Medical and Nursing Students and Staff in a Tertiary Care Hospital
pmc-11498074.creator: Shrinivas R Raikar, Sneha Sneha, Sreeraj G, Janarthanan R
pmc-11498074.description: BackgroundPharmacovigilance is defined as the science and activities related to the detection, assessment, understanding, and prevention of adverse effects or other drug-related problems. Underreporting of adverse drug reactions (ADRs) is a global issue, and adequate knowledge among healthcare professionals is essential. Engaging young doctors and nursing professionals in pharmacovigilance is crucial for promoting ADR reporting.

pmc-12513398.title: An investigation into the potent anticancer, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities of a Punica granatum nanoemulgel
pmc-12513398.creator: Ahmad M Eid, Murad Abualhasan, Yara Khaliliya, Zeina Sinan, Aya Khaliliya
pmc-12513398.description: PurposeThe objective of this study is to formulate a nanoemulgel using Punica granatum (P. granatum) seed oil and study the antibacterial, anticancer, and anti-inflammatory properties.MethodsThe process to formulate a nanoemulsion from P. granatum seed oil involved using the self-nanoemulsifying technique, with Span 80 and Tween 80 serving as the emulsifying agents.

pmc-12775486.title: Histological prognostic factors in canine appendicular osteosarcoma: 57 cases (2014–2022)
pmc-12775486.creator: Hiroshi Miyagi, Sheryl Coutermarsh-Ott, Laura E Selmic, Sara Campuzano, Maci Raybuck, Brittany Ciepluch, Joanne Tuohy
pmc-12775486.description: Appendicular osteosarcoma is the most common primary malignant bone neoplasia in dogs, with a generally guarded prognosis. Multiple clinicopathological factors have been suggested to be associated with a negative prognosis in dogs with osteosarcoma. The objective of this study was to identify histopathological prognostic factors in canine appendicular osteosarcoma.

pmc-13100661.title: Top ten tips to manage patients after acute kidney injury
pmc-13100661.creator: Nicholas M Selby, Sophie De Seigneux, Turgay Saritas, Vincenzo Cantaluppi, Ana Belén Sanz, Stanislas Faguer, Jose Antonio Lopes, Marlies Ostermann, Joana Gameiro
pmc-13100661.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite high mortality, most patients who experience an episode of acute kidney injury (AKI) survive to hospital discharge. These patients are at increased risk for chronic kidney disease (CKD), recurrent AKI, cardiovascular events, hospital readmission, and premature mortality. AKI is causally linked to some of these longer-term outcomes, particularly CKD, but non-causal associations also serve to identify vulnerable patients at higher risk. In both scenarios, there is a role for improved post-discharge AKI care.

pmc-13147398.title: LINE-1 retrotransposons: Multifaceted functions and regulatory mechanisms in health and disease
pmc-13147398.creator: Xingyue Liu, Caizhou Zhong, Shenglan Wang, Qingyu Huang, Zheng Li
pmc-13147398.description: Long interspersed nuclear element-1 (LINE-1), a prominent class of retrotransposons, is abundantly distributed throughout mammalian genomes and plays critical roles in development, aging, and disease. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of the multifaceted functions of LINE-1, with a focus on its regulatory impact on gene transcription and cellular responses across the DNA, RNA, and protein levels.

pmc-13325558.title: Retinoic Acid Signalling Regulates Zebrafish Tooth Germ Repair Following Injury
pmc-13325558.creator: Qiqi Liu, Zhenan Zhang, Weifeng Hao, Chunyan Zhou, Deqin Yang
pmc-13325558.description: Although the role of retinoic acid (RA) signalling in odontogenesis is well established, its involvement in the repair of injured tooth germs remains unclear. To investigate this, we generated a Tg(scpp5:Dendra2‐NTR) zebrafish line for labelling tooth germ cells and established a tooth germ injury model using the nitroreductase (NTR)/metronidazole (MTZ) system.

pmc-13326050.title: Beyond the usual suspects: unmasking ALCAPA in pediatric cardiomyopathy – case report
pmc-13326050.creator: Alejandra Pedraza C, María Verónica Suárez F, Daniela Ballén-Pinilla, Sandra Milena Cuello-Mendoza, Valentina Melendro-Duque, Juan Camilo Hernández, J. P. Rozo
pmc-13326050.description: IntroductionAnomalous origin of the left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery (ALCAPA) is a rare but potentially lethal congenital heart disease. Delayed recognition may result in irreversible myocardial injury. Although the classic presentation occurs in infancy, atypical forms may appear in older children, making this entity a diagnostic challenge.

pmc-13535070.title: The value of adrenal venous sampling in unveiling the conundrum of double unilateral adrenal adenomas in a case of primary hyperaldosteronism
pmc-13535070.creator: Maab F Elhaj, Elabbass A Abdelmahmuod, Stephen F Beer, Tarik Elhadd
pmc-13535070.description: Primary hyperaldosteronism (PHA) is a cause of secondary hypertension, often due to adrenal adenoma. The diagnosis and management of multiple unilateral adrenal adenomas in PHA represent a unique challenge. Adrenal venous sampling (AVS) has become a pivotal diagnostic tool in these cases, providing critical information for accurate localization of aldosterone production.
